en.headline: HKUST 35th anniversary science showcase continues free at Central Harbourfront
en.dek: AIA Vitality Park event runs until 7pm today with research models, workshops and a 1991-drone light show over the harbour at 6:20pm.
body: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology is hosting the second day of its 35th Anniversary Impact Fiesta at AIA Vitality Park on the Central Harbourfront today.

Visitors can see full-scale models of the Hong Kong Operation Robot built for a national lunar mission and MUSICO, the university’s carbon-monitoring instrument now operating on the Tiangong space station, together with AI health tools, robotics demonstrations, STEM workshops and mixed-reality art installations.

The university said the free event also includes a Beyblade competition organised by its students’ union, live music and dance performances by student groups and guests, and food stalls. It closes tonight with a drone light show of 1,991 drones — matching the year of the university’s founding — over Victoria Harbour from 6:20pm to 6:30pm. Admission is free.

zh.headline: 科大35周年成果共享節今日中環海濱免費開放
zh.dek: AIA Vitality公園活動至晚上7時，展出科研模型及工作坊，晚上6時20分維港有1991架無人機匯演。
body: 香港科技大學今日在中環海濱AIA Vitality公園舉行35周年成果共享節第二日，歡迎公眾免費入場。
現場展出為國家登月任務設計的香港操作機械人一比一模型，以及目前在天宮空間站運作的碳監測載荷天韻相機模型，另有人工智能健康工具、機械人示範、STEM工作坊及混合實境藝術裝置。
科大表示，活動包括學生會主辦的爆旋陀螺比賽、學生團體及嘉賓的音樂舞蹈表演，以及美食攤檔。今晚6時20分至6時30分，1991架無人機將在維港上空進行光影匯演，數字呼應科大創校年份。入場免費。
